title: Earnings Results Schedule, Common Stock Offerings and Corporate Announcements by Financial Companies - Research Report on Empire State Realty, Axis Capital, Alexandria, Hancock, and Brown & Brown
主要内容: Empire State Realty Trust, Inc. (ESRT) completed its initial public offering, issuing approximately 82.2 million shares of Class A common stock at $13.00 per share, with underwriters purchasing up to nearly 10.7 million shares. The offering raised approximately $884.1 million, intended for transaction costs, fees, and cash payments to existing entity holders, including the Helmsley estate. Axis Capital Holdings Limited (AXS) will release Q3 2013 financial results after markets close on October 30, 2013, with the CEO and CFO hosting an investor teleconference on October 31, 2013. Alexandria Real Estate Equities Inc. (ARE) will release Q3 2013 operating and financial results on October 28, 2013, followed by a conference call and audio webcast on October 29, 2013. Brown & Brown Inc. (BRO) announced that it will release its Q3 2013 financial results after the market closes on October 14, 2013. Hancock Holding Co. (HBHC) announced that it will announce its Q3 2013 financial results after the market closes on October 24, 2013.
